summary: Complete e2e testing of Supabase JWT authentication unification. All backend endpoints and frontend UI elements working correctly.

minor.issue: Was using get_current_user instead of require_auth causing 500 error on unauthenticated requests. FIXED - changed to require_auth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Supabase JWT authentication is now fully integrated. All legacy /auth/* endpoints have been removed (returning 404). Protected endpoints properly require Supabase JWT tokens. The frontend correctly shows Email/Password fields, Sign In button, OR divider, Continue with Apple, and Continue with Google buttons. Both OAuth providers redirect to their respective sign-in pages correctly.

tests: Public endpoints: GET /api/signals works without auth
Protected endpoints reject no token: GET /api/subscription/status returns 401
Protected endpoints reject no token: GET /api/admin/rbac/admins returns 401
Protected endpoints reject no token: GET /api/settings/profile returns 401
Supabase token verification: Valid token returns 200 for /api/subscription/status
Supabase token verification: Valid token returns profile data for /api/settings/profile
Continue with Apple button present and redirects to Apple sign-in
Continue with Google button present and redirects to Google OAuth
